allocation: round-robin across deterministic activity segments, then chronological output
omissions: every omitted event is counted and retained as a segment/day drill-down identity
drillDown: segment identity is stable from thread ID and first full-history event ID
fullHistoryBoundary: load selected threads beyond the requested period to preserve cross-boundary activity identity
remoteSynthesis: not performed by the context packer
claims: no generated factual summary; messages and provenance are evidence only
recalibration: change the policy version and rerun context, benchmark, and release evidence
